# Render3D Core Profile 1 - backend checklist

What a backend has to implement, and nothing else: the entries the profile says a backend
owns. A backend declares one by writing `@handles: <feature>` in a comment on the code that
does it, which is what makes a deleted handler stop claiming coverage.
